svg.title: The four test batches, twelve photos each
svg.desc: Four labelled strips of twelve photo thumbnails. The first strip is bright daylight, the second lamplight, the third the object held in a hand, the fourth an odd patterned background. Every strip shows the same three objects.
svg.text: Four batches. Twelve photos each. Same objects.
Change ONE thing per batch. Same three objects, every time.
If you change the objects too, you will never know which change caused the drop.
